summary_en: This study tests pembrolizumab with or without ablation (cryoablation or histotripsy) in people with metastatic or locally advanced triple negative breast cancer. Pembrolizumab is given at 200 mg every 3 weeks as part of standard care, and participants are randomly assigned in a 2 to 1 ratio to ablation plus pembrolizumab or pembrolizumab alone. The main outcome is not stated; the study is Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa pembrolizumab con o sin ablación (crioablación o histotripsia) en personas con cáncer de mama triple negativo metastásico o localmente avanzado. El pembrolizumab se administra a 200 mg cada 3 semanas como parte del tratamiento estándar, y los participantes se asignan al azar en una proporción de 2 a 1 a ablación más pembrolizumab o solo pembrolizumab. El resultado principal no está indicado; el estudio es de Fase 1.
who_for: Confirmed triple negative breast cancer that is metastatic or locally advanced and inoperable
At least one site suitable for cryoablation, at least 1.5 cm in size
Physically fit to undergo ablation under usual clinical practice
Planned pembrolizumab as first, second, or third line therapy
not_for: Not eligible for a PD-1 inhibitor according to the patient's medical oncologist
No disease that can be treated with ablation
Pembrolizumab not planned as part of standard of care
